title: Expert Relevance Score Annotation Schema
description: Schema for independently assigned human expert relevance scores (0-100).

expert_relevance_score.description: Expert human rating of overall fit/relevance for the role (0-100).

evaluator_id.description: Anonymized identifier for the human expert / rater.

scoring_rationale.description: Qualitative summary of why this score was assigned.

adjudicated.description: Whether this record is a post-disagreement consensus/adjudicated score.
